records.assessment: S236-a A1 identifies a crack as the early warning, A3 reads the leaning piano as its enlargement, and A5 reads the tilting audience as the same disaster reaching the concert. S236-b supplies the parallel typo growing into lost wedding space. The old transfer invented a warning sketch, a dismissal as decoration and a yesterday frame. The amended material uses the exact crack/piano/audience sequence and preserves the larger-version mechanism.
records.secondPassAssessment: Compatible with S236's exact mechanism: one early detail becomes the warning for successively larger versions of the same disaster. The proposed action and opening identify the little crack, matching candidate S236-single-a A1. The response develops B2's leaning piano and A3's widening crack; the challenge reproduces B4's tilting front row and evacuation; the closing follows A5's audience, balcony and threatened concert collapse. Clearing the balcony is supported by candidate A5, although absent from the historical original. The original transfer's warning sketch was unsupported by either original dialogue; the amendment removes it and replaces the abstract response and closing with the candidate's concrete escalation. Both original and candidate S236-single-b trace invitation error through cake error to reception displacement; they support the repeated, enlarging disaster mechanism, but do not supply the proposed piano or balcony details. The alternatives use meaningfully different pressures: physical evacuation and bargaining over a shared wedding reception. All transfer fields were considered: cardId, fingerprint, seedIds, seedBindingHashes and reviewStatus remain unchanged; {prop}, {request} and {counter} remain substitution points. Residual limitation: the fixed piano, front row, hall and balcony require a compatible concert setting, so arbitrary {prop}, request or counter substitutions could break coherence. The historical seed hashes do not establish binding to the candidate dialogue; that remains for the stated integration step. No bespoke pairs or supporting seeds were supplied, and this assessment does not constitute a compiled-pair review.
